seed.note: Two synthetic Bot objects added to the Web_Service skeleton's Configuration.xml, each combining Predefined and Picture the opposite way, so the two properties can be told apart. Imported and re-exported by ibcmd 8.3.27.2214 itself -- the platform is the authority.

proven_claims: Bot record shape is {1,{1,<header>,<predefined 0|1>,<picture 4-tuple>},0}: Predefined is the bare flag right after the generic header block.

The picture 4-tuple is byte-identical in shape to CommonCommand/CommandGroup's own Picture descriptor: leading '4', picture_kind at index 1, reference sub-tuple at index 2 (bare '0' plus a StdPicture/CommonPicture uuid, or a bare '{0}' when unset), LoadTransparent at index 6.

Combined with the native UT 11.5.27.75 sample (Tasks/Bots/ОповещенияПользователейОСобытиях.xml: Predefined=false, no picture), these round-trips gave the full Predefined true/false and Picture set/unset partition needed to extend parse_common_command_picture_value to Bot.Picture.
non_claims: LoadTransparent=false was not independently observed; only LoadTransparent=true (БотБ) and the no-picture case (БотА, native UT bot) are proven. The reused parse_common_command_picture_value reads it from the same slot CommonCommand/CommandGroup already proved for LoadTransparent, not a Bot-specific observation of the false case.
